title: Clickless
description: Single source of truth for the manifest, layout and operation formats. The Zod (TypeScript) and Pydantic (Python) models are generated from this file.

PropValue.description: A single value, or an ordered list of values for a prop declared with `multiple`.

ChoiceCapabilities.description: A prop chosen from a fixed list: one value, or with `multiple` an ordered list of them.

multiple.description: The prop holds an ordered list of distinct entries from `values`, such as the visible columns of a table.

min.description: With `multiple`, the fewest entries the list may hold. Defaults to 0.

required.description: With `multiple`, entries from `values` the list must always hold, such as the tab of the page that is open. They can still be moved within the list.

ColorCapabilities.description: A prop that accepts any colour, written as #rrggbb.

suggested.description: Colours to prefer when the user names none or asks for a brand colour. Not a restriction.

textOn.description: Text is drawn on this colour, kept readable by the library: black or white, whichever reads better on it, or with `colorProp`, the colour held by that colour prop of the same component, turned black or white where it would be hard to read on this one.

against.description: The colour this one is drawn on, such as the page's, written as #rrggbb. A chosen colour that would be hard to see on it is pointed out to the user.

NumberCapabilities.description: A prop that accepts any number from `min` to `max`.

w.description: Width in columns. Absent for a component that has no size in the layout, such as a button or a menu the page places itself; such a component cannot be resized.

h.description: Height in rows. Present exactly when `w` is.

offeredValues.description: For each list prop, the values the manifest offered when this layout was saved. It tells a value the user removed apart from one that did not exist yet. Maintained by the library; ignored in a component's defaults.

group.description: Which components share one container on the page, such as a row of cards or a menu. Components are ordered only among those in the same group, and cannot be moved out of it. Components without a group form one group of their own.

columns.description: How many columns the region's grid has. At most 48, as a component's width; a component is at most 200 rows high.

title.description: What users call this part of the screen, such as "Sidebar". It tells the planner which region a request means when one prompt is sent to several.

grid.description: False when the region draws no grid of its own, and each group of components sits in a container of the page's. Otherwise every component is drawn in the region's one grid, in the layout's order.

OffScreen.description: Components the region has shown before that were not on screen when the layout was saved, such as the content of a tab that is not open. Their settings wait here and are applied again when they come back. A component a release deleted stays here too, unseen. At most 500 are kept; past that, the ones last in `order` are dropped. Maintained by the library.

order.description: Every component, on screen or off, in one order. It is where a component that comes back is placed. The layout's own `order` is the newer of the two for the components it lists.

formatVersion.description: The version of this layout's own shape, so a layout kept anywhere, by the engine or by the application, says how to read it.

description.description: What the value is, in words the model and the user would use, such as "The customer's first name".

required.description: Whether a call must give it. Defaults to true; an optional one may be left out.

values.description: The only texts accepted, such as the options of a drop-down. Absent means any text.

NumberParameter.description: A parameter that takes a number.

description.description: What the value is, in words the model and the user would use, such as "The customer's first name".

required.description: Whether a call must give it. Defaults to true; an optional one may be left out.

BooleanParameter.description: A parameter that is true or false.

description.description: What the value is, in words the model and the user would use, such as "The customer's first name".

required.description: Whether a call must give it. Defaults to true; an optional one may be left out.

FileParameter.description: A parameter that takes a file the user attached, such as a photo. The file itself never leaves the browser: a call names it by its position among the attachments.

description.description: What the value is, in words the model and the user would use, such as "The customer's first name".

required.description: Whether a call must give it. Defaults to true; an optional one may be left out.

accept.description: Media types accepted, such as "image/*" or "application/pdf". Absent means any file.

Action.description: Something the application can do for its user when asked, such as changing their name or opening a customer's record. The application carries it out itself, with the user's own sign-in.

name.description: How calls name it: a letter, then up to 63 letters, digits or _.

title.description: What users would call it, such as "Change your name".

description.description: When to use it, for the model.

mode.description: `write` changes something, and runs only once the user confirms. `read` only changes what is shown, such as opening a page, and runs at once.

ActionArgument.description: A value given for a parameter. For a file parameter, the position of the attached file, counting from 0.
